t: You're at St Mary's Catholic Cemetery on Harrow Road in Kensal Green, which has its own Catholic chapel. Mary Seacole is buried here, the Jamaican nurse famous for her work in the Crimean War. Beside her lies the American sculptor Edmonia Lewis, who moved to Rome in 1866. The conductor Sir John Barbirolli is here too, remembered for saving the Hallé Orchestra. So is Louis Wain, the artist of anthropomorphised cats. And there is Krystyna Skarbek, the Polish agent of the Special Operations Executive, who was called the bravest of the brave.
